Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

translations.web: There will be stability in your times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of Yahweh is your treasure.
translations.bsb: He will be the sure foundation for your times, a storehouse of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge. The fear of the LORD is Zion’s treasure.
translations.kjv: And wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times, and strength of salvation: the fear of the LORD is his treasure.
translations.asv: And there shall be stability in thy times, abundance of salvation, wisdom, and knowledge: the fear of Jehovah is thy treasure.
